caption:
Stop blaming your thermostat for a hot bedroom.

Ordinary curtains let afternoon sun pour straight through the fabric, and that light carries heat into the room long after the sun moves on. Walls and air soak it up, so the room stays warm well into the evening.

These are thermal insulated blackout panels, two of them, built to block that heat along with the light instead of just filtering it. With over fifty thousand ratings averaging 4.6 stars, plenty of people have noticed the room runs darker and steadier because of it.

A room that stays cooler in the day and goes properly dark at night, for about $14.
